# ChunkMap

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

Chunk coordinates to chunk entity, for the live (not unloading) chunks.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by ChunkManagerSys::preinit; ChunkManagerSys inserts new chunks and erases unloaded ones. get(pos) returns entt::null when absent. TerrainColliders reads loaded densities through it (falls back to TerrainGenerator::sample otherwise). Keyed with IVec3Hash.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chunks` | `std::unordered_map<glm::ivec3, entt::entity, IVec3Hash>` | empty | chunk coordinates to entity |
